note: déclaration explicite : le bon est une incitation à conclure le contrat d'approvisionnement et à acheter massivement les produits d'AMD ; traitement fiscal convenu en remise ou rabais sur les fournitures du contrat
quote: This Warrant is being issued pursuant to the terms of the Product Purchase Agreement for AMD Instinct Products by and between the Company and OpenAI dated October 5, 2025 (the "Supply Agreement"), and is intended as a material inducement for OpenAI to enter into the Supply Agreement and as an incentive for OpenAI to make substantial purchases of the Company's products thereunder.

note: clause de conditionnalité : la résiliation pour faute du contrat d'approvisionnement par AMD annule les parts non acquises ou non exerçables ; échéance du bon 5 octobre 2030
quote: All (x) Warrant Shares that are then unvested or (y) Vested Warrant Shares that are not then exercisable shall be automatically cancelled upon the earlier of (i) the early termination of the Supply Agreement for cause by the Company or (ii) the Expiration Date.
trigger_description: the early termination of the Supply Agreement for cause by the Company

note: traitement fiscal convenu : remise ou rabais sur les fournitures du contrat d'approvisionnement, non rémunération
quote: treat this Agreement entered into pursuant to the terms of the Supply Agreement as giving rise to a sales discount or allowance in respect of the supply of product made in connection with the Supply Agreement.
